claim.quote: The first four naked high purity Germanium detectors were installed successfully in liquid nitrogen in the GENIUS-Test-Facility (GENIUS-TF) in the GRAN SASSO Underground Laboratory on May 5, 2003. This is the first time ever that this novel technique

name: First 10 kg of Naked Germanium Detectors in Liquid Nitrogen installed in the GENIUS-Test-Facility

summary.plain: In May 2003 the first four bare germanium crystals were lowered into liquid nitrogen deep under the Gran Sasso mountain, the first underground test of a way to cut radioactive background.
summary.technical: Four naked HPGe detectors (10.52 kg) in a thin-walled copper box of purified liquid nitrogen, installed 5 May 2003 in LNGS; first operating parameters reported.

title: First 10 kg of Naked Germanium Detectors in Liquid Nitrogen installed in the GENIUS-Test-Facility
why_it_matters: First underground test of naked Ge detectors in liquid nitrogen, the key idea of the proposed GENIUS observatory.
